svg.title: Function calling: provider comparison
svg.desc: <g font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace"> <rect x="64" y="136" width="330" height="414" fill="#17222d"/> <text x="96" y="188" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="21">ONE TEST SUITE</text> <text x="96" y="244" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">01 route selection</text> <text x="96" y="286" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">02 arguments</text> <text x="96" y="328" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">03 schema errors</text> <text x="96" y="370" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">04 tool failure</text> <path d="M96 426H350" stroke="#d9572b" stroke-width="5"/> <text x="96" y="478" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="17">EXPECTED != PLAUSIBLE</text> </g> <path d="M394 343H506" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/><path d="m490 331 20 12-20 12" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/> <g font-family="DejaVu Sans, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700"> <rect x="530" y="136" width="276" height="178" fill="#dbe7e5"/><text x="566" y="211" fill="#17222d">PROVIDER A</text><text x="566" y="255" fill="#277187" font-size="18">native schema</text> <rect x="530" y="372" width="276" height="178" fill="#dbe7e5"/><text x="566" y="447" fill="#17222d">PROVIDER B</text><text x="566" y="491" fill="#277187" font-size="18">native schema</text> <rect x="884" y="224" width="332" height="238" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/><text x="920" y="304" fill="#17222d">TOOLS</text><text x="920" y="356" fill="#6c7478" font-size="18">lookup · quote · cancel</text><text x="920" y="402" fill="#d9572b" font-size="18">compare actual calls</text> </g> <path d="M806 225H884M806 461H884" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/>
